name: Medix
about: A network of medical centres: registration and call centre, laboratory, imaging, IT of the clinics and settlements with NFZ.

personas.name: Elżbieta Kurowska
personas.style: Practical. Counts patients, calls and queues. Lists the complaints of the front desk, then gives the exact request.

personas.name: Wiktoria Sobolewska
personas.style: Young and chatty: 'hejka', 'mega', 'serio'. Many questions in one message, but one clear request.

personas.name: Olena Kovalenko
personas.style: Simple Polish sentences, sometimes wrong word order. Always asks at the end if she wrote it correctly.

personas.name: Teresa Wróblewska
personas.role: Head of the laboratory, a laboratory diagnostician
personas.style: Pedantic. Exact laboratory words (morfologia, CRP, probówka EDTA) and numbers with units.

personas.name: Norbert Szulc
personas.style: Terse technical lines about protocols (HL7, ASTM). Always uses issue keys.

personas.name: Ksenia Borowska
personas.role: Laboratory technician on the night shift
personas.style: Writes at night, tired. Short sentences, small typos, mentions the time and the night shift.

personas.name: Leszek Nowakowski
personas.style: Impatient radiologist. Abbreviations (TK, MR, USG, opis), no greetings, writes between examinations.

personas.name: Iwona Stachowiak
personas.style: Tells step by step what happened at the device. Does not know issue keys and describes the issue in words.

personas.name: Erik Johansson
personas.style: English with a few Polish words that he knows (dziękuję, proszę, dzień dobry).

personas.name: Arkadiusz Mikulski
personas.role: Head of IT of all clinics
personas.style: Talks about plans and budgets. Names the clinic by its district (Mokotów, Wola, Ursynów).

personas.name: Tadeusz Wrona
personas.style: Grumpy old administrator. Very short, device names in capital letters, complains about the users.

personas.name: Dominika Ryba
personas.style: Passes on what the staff said, with their words in quotes. Kind and a little chaotic.

personas.name: Stanisław Góral
personas.style: Very firm and does not accept objections. Superlatives, capital letters, 'natychmiast', blames other people. Short sentences, the request is clear.

personas.name: Grażyna Pietruszka
personas.style: Calm and exact. Names the NFZ deadlines and the codes of the services.

personas.name: Jakub Sowiński
personas.style: Asks with numbers and percentages. Uses English data words (dashboard, query, outlier).
